title: Exception in streamText not forwarded to response promise

linked_prs.title: fix(ai): streamText promises reject when stream has errors
linked_prs.body:
## Background

The `streamText` promises did not prevent the node VM from finishing (see #6522 and #7826 ) when errors happened in the stream. The promises were never rejected nor resolved, and the Node.js process exited because the event loop was empty.

## Summary

* the stream text promises automatically consume the stream
* the stream text promises are rejected when the stream is empty (e.g. due to errors)

## Manual Verification

Tested examples from #6522 and #7826

## Related Issues

Fixes #6522
Fixes #7826
